title.full: Claiming a deceased person’s bank balances

summary.text: For $5,000 or less, contact the bank. For more, the Public Trustee may help up to $50,000.

steps.name: Check the balance
steps.text: If the balance is $5,000 or below, approach the bank. If it is more than $5,000 and up to $50,000, the Public Trustee’s Office may help on a case-by-case basis.

items: For $5,000 or below, approach the bank directly.
For more than $5,000 to $50,000, the Public Trustee’s Office may assist case by case.

steps.name: Contact the bank
steps.text: If the balance is $5,000 or below, approach the bank directly to claim the deceased’s bank money.

items: Approach the bank directly to claim the deceased’s bank money.

steps.name: Apply to the Public Trustee
steps.text: If the balance is more than $5,000 and up to $50,000, apply online. The Public Trustee’s Office may assist on a case-by-case basis.

items: Apply online to have the Public Trustee administer the deceased’s estate.
Select “Deceased’s Assets other than Un-nominated CPF Moneys / Baby Bonus / Edusave / PSEA”.
Disclose the deceased’s shares, bank savings account, death gratuity, insurance policies and vehicles, if any.

about.text: You need Singpass to access the online form. If you cannot apply for Singpass, apply for a login ID and password through the Public Trustee’s website.

quotes.text: Bank account balance $5,000 or below For your convenience and in order to save costs at your end, you may approach the bank directly to claim the Deceased’s bank moneys.
The Public Trustee’s Office may assist to administer such cases on a case-by-case basis.

You will need to have your Singpass ready in order to access our online application form. You may apply for your Singpass at https://www.singpass.gov.sg if you do not have one. If you are ineligible to apply for a Singpass, you may apply for a login ID and password through our website: https://go.gov.sg/pto.
